name: facturacion-electronica-cr
description: Simulador educativo de comprobantes electrónicos de Costa Rica (Anexos y Estructuras v4.4). No envía comprobantes reales.

scripts.dev:firebase: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-fe-cr
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:reglas: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-fe-cr "npm run test:reglas -w functions"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w functions
scripts.test:integracion: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-fe-cr "npm run test:integracion -w functions"
